title: Dynamic and demand-based system planning
summary: Support supply of trained workers that can adjust to changing employment and technology demand.

title: Labour Market Information System
summary: Establish sector-specific LMIS at national/state levels and area-specific LMIS at local levels to undertake labour market analysis.

title: Human Resource Planning
summary: Gauge anticipated supply and demand of skilled workers by skill level, economic sector, geography and time period.

title: Labour-market information dissemination
summary: Disseminate LMIS/HRP information to government, employers, training providers, trainees and prospective trainees to support decisions.

title: Skill inventory
summary: Create a skill inventory with levels and grades as part of the talent-pool approach.

title: Employment outcomes
summary: Monitor placement ratios and make employment outcomes visible for skill-training programmes.

title: Short, relevant courses
summary: Use short, relevant and effective courses that respond to fast-changing labour-market skills.

title: Local labour-market support
summary: Village/block skill centres are described as information points for local labour-market, employment, training and support-scheme information.

title: Unorganised-sector skills
summary: The policy explicitly addresses own-account workers, micro-enterprise workers, casual labourers, home-based workers, migrants, farmers and artisans.
